result.topic_en: Gauss computes values related to the lemniscatic functions, P and Q with argument (1+√-1) and their squares and fourth powers, and expresses them in terms of p and q; he also gives the differential relations $P_{xx}=\alpha PQ$, $Q_{xx}=\sqrt{Q^4-P^4}$, series coefficient checks, and a theta-type series for $Q^4$.
